record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, test mild positive frequency scaling of history embeddings: multiply by clamp((max(training_item_count,1)/median_positive_count)^0.10,0.9,1.1), keeping padding zero. Previous inverse-frequency scaling regressed; modestly emphasizing frequent observed items may provide more reliable recurrent inputs. Compute counts solely from training interactions and checkpoint the scales for identical inference. Preserve learned embeddings, GRU topology, readout, candidate scoring, loss and optimizer.
